acceptance_criteria: 全公開関数に正常系と異常系がある
scope: All 110 public functions (module functions and class methods in src/verified_execution and server_mcp.py) are listed in tests/unit_inventory.json with a normal and an abnormal test. The list of public functions is computed from the source, and the listed tests are re-run under a sys.monitoring tracer that checks each declared outcome (return, raise, error value, absent result, or handled abnormal input). Total functions, which have no failure outcome, are marked handled with the reason. A traced run found 20 functions without a normal test and 35 without an abnormal one; tests/test_unit_gaps.py adds them (RequestCancellation had no test at all).
